description: Ghostly Strike Talent 40 Energy Melee Range Instant 20 sec cooldown Requires Rogue Requires Melee Weapon A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.
name: Ghostly Strike
